command:
set -euo pipefail
BRANCH='chatgpt-work/entityos-crush-omega-bootstrap-20260913'
EXPECTED_HEAD='bbca92180f7d11b38b4679d39a1bb79db8918e60'
DONOR='d333e04385f9e1d1523cea7b417cb5e8798a713a'
ROOT=$(mktemp -d /tmp/crush005-route-validate.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$ROOT"' EXIT
printf 'CRUSH005_BOUNDARY=REAL_LOCAL_HOST_AI_CORE_NODE_NOT_SANDBOXED\n'
printf 'HOST=%s\nOWNER=%s\n' "$(hostname)" "$(id -un)"
LIVE=("$HOME/harness_crush_knopf.sh" "$HOME/harness_crush_knopf.py" "$HOME/harness_crush.py" "$HOME/frankenstein-repo/CRUSH.md")
: > "$ROOT/live.before"
for p in "${LIVE[@]}"; do test -f "$p"; sha256sum "$p" | tee -a "$ROOT/live.before"; done
gh repo clone gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity "$ROOT/research" -- --quiet --single-branch --branch "$BRANCH"
ACTUAL_HEAD=$(git -C "$ROOT/research" rev-parse HEAD)
printf 'RESEARCH_HEAD=%s\n' "$ACTUAL_HEAD"
test "$ACTUAL_HEAD" = "$EXPECTED_HEAD"
git clone --quiet https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush.git "$ROOT/donor"
git -C "$ROOT/donor" checkout --quiet "$DONOR"
printf 'DONOR_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git -C "$ROOT/donor" rev-parse HEAD)"
rm -rf "$ROOT/donor/internal/omega"
cp -a "$ROOT/research/research_entity/coordination/entityos_crush_seed/internal/omega" "$ROOT/donor/internal/omega"
GO_VERSION='go1.27.1'
META=$(curl -fsSL 'https://go.dev/dl/?mode=json&include=all')
GO_SHA=$(printf '%s' "$META" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; data=json.load(sys.stdin); target="go1.27.1.linux-amd64.tar.gz"; print(next(f["sha256"] for r in data for f in r.get("files",[]) if f.get("filename")==target))')
curl -fsSL "https://go.dev/dl/${GO_VERSION}.linux-amd64.tar.gz" -o "$ROOT/go.tgz"
printf '%s  %s\n' "$GO_SHA" "$ROOT/go.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
tar -C "$ROOT" -xzf "$ROOT/go.tgz"
"$ROOT/go/bin/go" version
cd "$ROOT/donor"
"$ROOT/go/bin/go" test ./internal/omega -count=1
: > "$ROOT/live.after"
for p in "${LIVE[@]}"; do sha256sum "$p" | tee -a "$ROOT/live.after"; done
cmp "$ROOT/live.before" "$ROOT/live.after"
printf 'CRUSH005_EXTERNAL_ROUTE_GO_TEST_PASS\nCRUSH005_LIVE_HARNESS_BYTE_INVARIANT_PASS\n'
